The '''Genesis pool''' was a construct designed by the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Remulus Dreypa]] and left abandoned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syngia]]. The Genesis pool was filled with strange organic substances, and attracted the attention of [[biochemist]]s affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reorganized Sith Empire]].

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Genesis pool was first mentioned as part of the Bioanalysis Crew Skill mission "The Genesis Pool" in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
